==English== ===Etymology=== Origin {{unc|en|nocap=1}}. Perhaps an alteration of {{inh|en|enm|snacche|t=a trap, snare}}, {{m|enm|snacchen|t=to seize (prey)|pos=whence modern {{m+|en|snatch}}}}. Compare also {{cog|enm|snik snak|t=a sudden blow, snap}}. Alternatively, perhaps from a dialectal variant of {{doublet|en|sneak|notext=1}}, from {{inh|en|enm|sniken}}, from {{inh|en|ang|snīcan|t=to creep; crawl}}. More at {{l|en|sneak}}, {{l|en|snatch}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/snɪt͡ʃ/}} * {{audio|en|en-us-snitch.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|ɪtʃ|s=1}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|slang|intransitive}} To [[inform on]] someone, especially in betrayal of others. # {{lb|en|slang|intransitive}} {{rfv-sense|en}} To [[contact]] or [[cooperate]] with the police for any reason. # {{lb|en|slang|dated|transitive}} To [[steal]], quickly and quietly. ====Synonyms==== * {{sense|to steal}} {{l|en|filch}}, {{l|en|nick}}, {{l|en|pilfer}}, {{l|en|pocket}}; See also [[Thesaurus:steal]] * {{sense|to inform on}} {{l|en|drop a dime}}, {{l|en|grass up}}, {{l|en|rat out}}; See also [[Thesaurus:rat out]] * {{sense|cooperate with the police}} ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|snitchee|snitcher|antisnitching|dry snitch|snitch up|snitch-jacket}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top-see|steal|steal|shoplift}} * Bulgarian: * Czech: * Dutch: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Indonesian: * Italian: * Macedonian: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{t+|ru|стащить}} * Swedish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|inform on}} * Albanian: * Arabic: * Bulgarian: * Chinese: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Hebrew: * Italian: * Macedonian: * Norwegian: * Old English: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{t+|ru|нашёптывать|impf}}, {{t+|ru|нашепта́ть|pf}} * Spanish: * Swedish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|contact or cooperate with the police}} * Czech: * Dutch: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Russian: {{t+|ru|стучать}}, {{t+|ru|доносить}} * Swedish: {{trans-bottom}} ===Noun=== [[File:The Making of Harry Potter 29-05-2012 (Golden Snitch).jpg|thumb|A Golden '''Snitch'''.]] {{en-noun}} #
